why: Old names stay out of the repo once renamed. A name may appear only in the files listed for it, each with a reason; docs_check.py enforces this in CI and before push.

names.why: the rater comparison was renamed: jevaluate-eval/rater-agreement.md, rater_agreement/rater_agreement.py; the write-up is EVAL-RESULTS.md; the rubric findings log is jevaluate/rubric-tuning-log.md
in jev-mode, calibration means tuning on labeled results (rubric.md, closes_loop: calibrates), not rater agreement; say rater agreement or rubric tuning

allowed.jevaluate/rubric.md: golden: the rubric's own meaning (calibrates: labeled results change the numbers)
allowed.jevaluate/SKILL.md: golden: Jev answers with calibrated probabilities
allowed.shared/jev-rules.md: golden: names TypeSafe's sentences on calibration
allowed.jevaluate/fix-catalog.md: the calibrate fix: tune thresholds on labels
allowed.jevaluate/scripts/coverage_manifest.py: finds threshold and calibration code in rated projects
allowed.ratings/*.md: published ratings describe and quote rated projects
allowed.ratings/full/*.md: published ratings describe and quote rated projects
allowed.jev-lens/*.md: Jev Lens tunes its decoder to the user (calibrate.md)
allowed.jev-sources/*.json: routing words for TypeSafe's confidence and calibration docs
allowed.study/index.html: the study course quotes TypeSafe's docs on calibration
